info: This slide is ignored during rendering - use it to document your deck format

slideTypes.title: Hero slide with eyebrow, title, subtitle, and media strip
slideTypes.standard: Basic slide with badge, headline, body, and optional image
slideTypes.scroll: Long-form page with a lead paragraph and ## section headings
slideTypes.grid: Grid of images or color swatches
slideTypes.gallery: Gallery of images with labels and copy
slideTypes.image: Full-bleed visual with optional caption overlay

fontPresets.custom: Use any font name like 'Comic Sans MS', 'Georgia', etc.

universalFields.headline: optional - main heading
universalFields.body: optional - text or array of paragraphs
universalFields.image: optional - image object {src, alt, aspectRatio, objectFit, objectPosition, border, orientation}
universalFields.caption: optional - overlay text for image slides
universalFields.autoBadge: optional - set to false to hide auto-generated badges
universalFields.font: optional - font preset or custom font name

callouts.note: A callout is a body item: put it in the body array alongside paragraphs.

scrollVariants.two-column: Long-form page set in two CSS columns with a rule between them
scrollVariants.note: Set "variant": "two-column" on a scroll slide for a dense reference page.
